Unique Research × Geili Messages · Insight / Market Report · November 1, 2024 · Data through Sept 2024

Ingest note: CN package has ~16 charts/tables. EN keeps methodology + headline numbers. Attach originals or redraw EN labels on import.

Report meta

  • Title: 2024 Q3 China Foundation-Model Business Report
  • Publishers: Unique Research & Geili Messages · Data: Geili · As of: end-Sept 2024

Market snapshot (Jan–Sept 2024)

  • 765 awarded projects · total value >¥2.1B · average award ¥5.76M
  • vs full-year 2023: award count +468%

01 · Award boards

By count: iFlytek 20 · China Telecom 19 · China Mobile 12. iFlytek covers telco, finance, energy, education — from smart CS / coding assist / smart procurement / contract review to training-inference and model-ops platforms.

By cumulative ¥: iFlytek Zhiyuan ¥199M · Yunshang Kunpeng ¥177M · Inspur Software ¥148M.

By average ¥: Yunshang Kunpeng ¥177M (incl. East-Data-West-Compute Gui’an cluster companion project) · Zhiyuan Tech / iFlytek Zhiyun tied at ¥99.46M. Oct 14: iFlytek × CNOOC × China Telecom “Haineng” energy model noted.

02 · Trends

Monthly award count rose Jan→Sept; Sept peak 211 projects (period mean ~85 / median 41). Cumulative monthly ¥ volatile: Jan low ¥13.83M → Aug peak ¥680M (mean ¥234M / median ¥168M). Average deal size ranged ¥1.97M–¥13.42M; period mean ~¥5.61M.

03 · Buyer type

  • Count: SOEs 418 · government/institutions 286
  • Cumulative ¥: SOEs ¥1.139B · gov/institutions ¥766M · private ¥142M
  • Average ¥: private ¥12.93M · SOE ¥8.56M · gov/institutions ¥3.61M (some SOE amounts undisclosed)

04 · Geography

Count leaders: Beijing 162 · Guangdong 98 · Zhejiang 69. Cumulative ¥ led by Guizhou ¥576M (large East-Data-West-Compute Gui’an awards; CMCC Systems Integration won one ~¥224M bid on ~¥250M budget) — Yunnan low ¥150k. Guizhou average ¥82.27M; most provinces <¥5M average.

05 · Industry

Count: campuses/universities 207 · operators 198. Cumulative ¥: finance ¥663M · government affairs ¥410M. Average: finance ~¥20M · healthcare/RE ~¥14M · campuses ~¥1.6M.

Takeaways

Bid activity shows broad industry demand and rising customization. Models support smart city, manufacturing, fintech, healthcare digitalization. Policy tailwinds in healthcare/education. Vendors must pair technical breakthroughs with precise, personalized delivery.

— END —
